scenario.zh: 某连锁餐厅午市电话订座激增，人工接听常占线漏单，需配置AI话务分流
scenario.en: A restaurant chain faces lunch rush phone overflow; configure AI to route reservations

output.zh: AI仅在人工全忙时介入，高峰保底接通但平时仍人工优先
output.en: AI steps in only when staff unavailable; peak coverage with human priority off-peak

output.zh: 所有来电先由AI分类处理，复杂咨询再转人工，话务量大幅减轻
output.en: All calls screened by AI first; complex queries escalated, workload greatly reduced

instruction.zh: 定义AI如何处理常见订座请求
instruction.en: Define how AI handles reservation requests

output.zh: 脚本更新：收集姓名、人数、时段后立即确认，快速但灵活性低
output.en: Script updated: collect name, size, time then confirm; fast but less flexible

output.zh: 脚本更新：先问窗边或包间、有无儿童座椅需求，体验更佳但通话稍长
output.en: Script updated: ask window/private room, child seat needs; better experience, slightly longer

instruction.zh: 检查两种场景下的AI对话流程
instruction.en: Review AI conversation flow in two scenarios

output.zh: AI礼貌告知无空位，推荐外卖或晚市替代，记录回电需求并致歉
output.en: AI politely notes no availability, suggests takeout or dinner, logs callback and apologizes

output.zh: AI确认预订细节，告知到店注意事项，发送短信确认码并感谢来电
output.en: AI confirms booking details, shares arrival notes, sends SMS code and thanks caller

instruction.zh: 最终检查配置并生成交付清单

output.zh: 应答脚本、转接规则、短信模板已整理，可交付门店培训使用
output.en: Call script, routing rules, SMS templates compiled; ready for store training

output.zh: 建议先用内线模拟高峰、满座、特殊需求场景，确认AI应答自然流畅
output.en: Recommend internal test calls simulating peak, full slots, special requests for natural flow

takeaway.zh: IVRy让餐饮等行业低成本接入对话AI，从占线保底到全流程分流均可配置
takeaway.en: IVRy enables restaurants to adopt conversational AI affordably, from overflow to full routing

initial.zh: 午间订座：问姓名、人数、时段，满座推荐外卖或晚市，记录回电号码
initial.en: Lunch reservations: ask name, party size, time; if full suggest takeout or dinner, log callback
